_meta.definition: The process of managing and maintaining information related to geographical features such as cities, countries, continents, deserts, islands, lakes, rivers, seas, and mountains.

geo_desert._description: Records geographical locations of deserts within their respective countries and provinces.

columns.name: Desert
columns.description: Stores names of Kalahari Deserts in multiple locations.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores two-letter country codes for countries associated with deserts in Angola, Namibia, and Zaire (Z).

columns.name: Province
columns.description: Stores geographical provinces associated with deserts.

geo_estuary._description: Captures geographical information about estuaries where rivers flow into specific countries and provinces.

columns.name: River
columns.description: Stores names of up to 50 characters for major rivers in various geographical locations.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for estuaries.

columns.name: Province
columns.description: Stores the names of provinces or counties for estuaries located in Iceland and Scandinavian countries.

geo_island._description: Captures geographical data of islands, including their names, associated countries, and provinces.

columns.name: Island
columns.description: Stores names of various islands, such as Svalbard, Greenland, Iceland, Aust-Vagoey, Streymoy.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores abbreviated names of countries associated with geographical islands.

columns.name: Province
columns.description: Stores geographical names of provinces or regions associated with islands.

geo_lake._description: Tracks geographical distribution of lakes across countries and provinces.

columns.name: Lake
columns.description: Stores names of up to 50 characters for freshwater lakes in Finland.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code for the country where the lake is located.

columns.name: Province
columns.description: Stores Finnish provincial names for geographical lakes.

geo_river._description: Tracks geographical distribution of rivers across countries and provinces.

columns.name: River
columns.description: Stores names of up to 50 characters for various rivers.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for rivers.

columns.name: Province
columns.description: Stores names of provinces or counties along rivers in Iceland and Norway.

geo_sea._description: Records geographical data of seas within specific provinces of various countries.

columns.name: Sea
columns.description: Stores names of seas bordering multiple countries in the Mondial database.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes for countries bordering the sea.

columns.name: Province
columns.description: Stores geographical entities within Denmark or possibly Norwegian provinces.

geo_source._description: Tracks geographical sources of rivers across countries and provinces.

columns.name: River
columns.description: Stores names of up to 50 characters for various rivers worldwide.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes for geographical data sources.

columns.name: Province
columns.description: Stores geographical regions (e.g., Iceland, Soer Trondelag, Oppland) within countries for geo_source table.

located._description: Records geographical locations of cities, provinces, countries, rivers, lakes, and seas in the Mondial database.

columns.name: City
columns.description: Stores names of cities in Albania and Greece.

columns.name: Province
columns.description: Stores geographical regions for locations, with examples including Albania, Attiki, Anatoliki Makedhonia kai Thraki.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes for countries where vehicles are located.

columns.name: River
columns.description: The River column stores names of major European rivers.

columns.name: Lake
columns.description: Stores names of lakes from various countries.

columns.name: Sea
columns.description: Stores names of seas within the Mediterranean region.

locatedOn._description: Captures geographical locations of entities within Mondial database, including city, province/state, country, and island.

columns.name: City
columns.description: Stores city names of locations where Mondial companies are based.

columns.name: Province
columns.description: Stores geographical regions where Mondial companies are located, such as islands or provinces.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for the location of a company.

columns.name: Island
columns.description: Stores names of islands where Mondial companies are located.

mountainOnIsland._description: Records islands worldwide and their associated mountain peaks.

columns.name: Mountain
columns.description: Stores names of up to 50 characters for mountains located on islands.

columns.name: Island
columns.description: Stores names of islands where mountains are located.

organization._description: Captures details of various organizations, including their abbreviations, names, locations (city, country, province), and establishment dates.

columns.name: Abbreviation
columns.description: Stores up to 50 characters of abbreviated names for international organizations such as ACP, AfDB, ACCT, OPANAL, AG.

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores names of international organizations, such as regional groups and development banks.
samples: Agency for Cultural and Technical Cooperation
Agency for the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons in Latin America and the Caribbean

columns.name: City
columns.description: Stores city names for various global organizations.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes for organizations.

columns.name: Province
columns.description: Stores geographical regions for organizations, represented by provinces, districts, or states.

columns.name: Established
columns.description: Stores organization establishment dates as formatted strings (YYYY-MM-DD).

_meta.definition: The process of managing geographical data related to cities, provinces, countries, mountains, languages, and religions.

city._description: Captures geographical and demographic information of cities worldwide.

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores city names for Albanian cities.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores the ISO 3166-2 alpha-2 code of the country where each city is located.

columns.name: Province
columns.description: Stores the country (Albania) for each city entry.

columns.name: Population
columns.description: Stores the number of inhabitants (in thousands) for each city.

columns.name: Longitude
columns.description: Stores geographical longitudes of cities in decimal degrees.

columns.name: Latitude
columns.description: Stores geographical latitude coordinates for cities.

ethnicGroup._description: Captures demographic data representing ethnic groups and their percentage distribution across various countries.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores the two-letter ISO country code for the predominant nation of origin within each ethnic group.

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores up to 50 characters of ethnic group names, such as Greeks, Albanians, and Serbs.

columns.name: Percentage
columns.description: Stores the proportion of individuals within each ethnic group in the Mondial database.

geo_mountain._description: Records geographical data of mountains, including their country and province locations.

columns.name: Mountain
columns.description: Stores names of up to 50 characters for prominent mountains worldwide.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores the ISO country code for the location of each mountain.

columns.name: Province
columns.description: Stores geographical provinces associated with mountain locations, as indicated by sample values.

language._description: Tracks linguistic composition of countries by recording their names and corresponding language percentages.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores ISO 3166-alpha-2 country codes for languages predominantly spoken.

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores the names of languages spoken in countries such as Albania, Macedonia, Turkey, Serbia.

columns.name: Percentage
columns.description: Stores the proportion of a language within the Mondial Corporation.

province._description: Represents geographical provinces within their respective countries, including details on population, area, capital city, and the relationship between capitals and provinces.

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores the names of provinces in various formats, such as Albania, Anatoliki Makedhonia kai Thraki, etc.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores the ISO 3166-2 alpha-2 code of the country for each province.

columns.name: Population
columns.description: Stores the number of inhabitants for each province.

columns.name: Area
columns.description: Stores the square kilometers of each province.

columns.name: Capital
columns.description: Stores names of capital cities for provinces.

columns.name: CapProv
columns.description: Stores the names of provinces or regions in various formats across multiple countries.

religion._description: Tracks religious demographics by country and denomination.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes for countries of religious affiliation.

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores religious denominations such as Muslim, Roman Catholic, Christian Orthodox.

columns.name: Percentage
columns.description: Stores the proportion (as a percentage) of each country's population that follows a specific religion.

_meta.definition: The process of managing various geographical features such as continents, countries, deserts, islands, lakes, rivers, and seas.

continent._description: Represents geographical continents and their respective areas in the Mondial database.

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores the names of continents: Europe, Asia, Australia/Oceania, Africa, America.

columns.name: Area
columns.description: Stores the approximate square kilometers of each continent.

country._description: Represents geographical entities with their respective names, codes, capitals, provinces, areas, and populations in a global context.

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores up to 50 characters of country names for Balkan nations.

columns.name: Code
columns.description: Stores ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes.

columns.name: Capital
columns.description: Stores city names of respective countries' capitals.

columns.name: Province
columns.description: Stores administrative divisions within countries, as indicated by sample values.

columns.name: Area
columns.description: Stores the total area (in square kilometers) of each country.

columns.name: Population
columns.description: Stores the total number of inhabitants for each country.

desert._description: Tracks geographical data for various desert regions worldwide.

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores names of major deserts worldwide.

columns.name: Area
columns.description: Stores the square kilometers of desert areas.

columns.name: Longitude
columns.description: Stores geographical longitudes for various desert locations.

columns.name: Latitude
columns.description: Stores geographical latitude coordinates for various desert locations.

islandIn._description: Records geographical relationships between islands, seas, lakes, and rivers.

columns.name: Island
columns.description: Stores names of islands in the Mondial database, primarily Svalbard and Greenland.

columns.name: Sea
columns.description: Stores names of seas surrounding the islands.

columns.name: Lake
columns.description: Stores names of lakes associated with islands worldwide.

columns.name: River
columns.description: The "River" column in the "islandIn" table stores names of rivers connecting islands.

lake._description: Tracks geographical data for various lakes worldwide, including their names, areas, depths, altitudes, types, rivers, and coordinates.

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores up to 50 characters of names for Finnish lakes.

columns.name: Area
columns.description: Stores surface area (in square kilometers) of various lakes.

columns.name: Depth
columns.description: Stores the water depth (in float) for various lakes.

columns.name: Altitude
columns.description: Stores the elevation (in float) of various lakes.

columns.name: Type
columns.description: Stores geological type of lake (impact, caldera).

columns.name: River
columns.description: Stores names of rivers that flow into the lake.

columns.name: Longitude
columns.description: Stores geographical longitudes of lakes in decimal degrees.

columns.name: Latitude
columns.description: Stores geographical latitude coordinates for various lakes.

river._description: Tracks geographical data for global rivers, including names, lengths, sources, and estuaries.

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores up to 50 characters of river names, primarily from Iceland and Scandinavia.

columns.name: River
columns.description: Stores names of up to 50 characters for major rivers worldwide.

columns.name: Lake
columns.description: Stores names of lakes connected to rivers.

columns.name: Sea
columns.description: Stores names of seas connected to rivers.

columns.name: Length
columns.description: Stores the length (in float) of various rivers.

columns.name: SourceLongitude
columns.description: Stores longitude coordinates of river sources.

columns.name: SourceLatitude
columns.description: Stores latitude coordinates of river sources.

columns.name: Mountains
columns.description: Stores names of mountain ranges bordering rivers.

columns.name: SourceAltitude
columns.description: Stores elevation (in meters) at the source of each river.

columns.name: EstuaryLongitude
columns.description: Stores longitude coordinates of estuaries where rivers flow into oceans.

columns.name: EstuaryLatitude
columns.description: Stores latitude coordinates of estuaries where rivers flow into oceans.

sea._description: Tracks geographical data for various ocean depths of the world's seas and oceans.

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores geographical names of seas.

columns.name: Depth
columns.description: Stores the water depths of various seas.

_meta.definition: The process of managing geographical territories such as cities, countries, and continents.

mergesWith._description: MergesWith table records historical sea mergers and acquisitions in the Mondial database.

columns.name: Sea1
columns.description: Stores names of seas involved in mergers.

columns.name: Sea2
columns.description: Stores names of bodies of water involved in mergers.

_meta.definition: The process of managing and analyzing economic indicators for countries

economy._description: Tracks economic data of countries, including GDP, agriculture, service, industry, and inflation rates.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes for countries in economy sector.

columns.name: GDP
columns.description: Stores the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) of various countries as floating point numbers.

columns.name: Agriculture
columns.description: Stores percentage of a country's GDP derived from agriculture.

columns.name: Service
columns.description: Stores average cost of services provided by each company.

columns.name: Industry
columns.description: The economy table's Industry column stores proportions of the national economy represented by various industries.

columns.name: Inflation
columns.description: Stores annual inflation rates as floating point numbers.

_meta.definition: The process of managing and analyzing demographic data related to population growth, infant mortality, and other relevant statistics for countries.

population._description: Tracks demographic data for various countries, including population size and growth rate, as well as infant mortality rates.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes for countries in the population table.

columns.name: Population_Growth
columns.description: Stores annual population growth rates as positive (growth) or negative (decline) floating point numbers.

columns.name: Infant_Mortality
columns.description: Stores infant mortality rates per 1000 live births.

_meta.definition: The process of managing nations, including registration, updates, and diplomatic relations.

politics._description: Tracks political information about countries, including their independence status, dependencies, and current governments.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes for countries in politics table.

columns.name: Independence
columns.description: Stores the date of political independence for respective countries.

columns.name: Dependent
columns.description: Stores ISO country codes of politically dependent territories.

columns.name: Government
columns.description: Stores political system type, ranging from emerging democracies to parliamentary republics.
samples: parliamentary democracy that retains as its heads of state a coprincipality

_meta.definition: The process of managing the membership and affiliations of countries and organizations within a unified system.

isMember._description: Tracks membership of organizations within specific countries across various types.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes for countries of member nations.

columns.name: Organization
columns.description: Stores the names of organizations that members belong to (e.g., ACP).

columns.name: Type
columns.description: Stores membership status of individuals within the Mondial organization (member, member, etc.)
